description: This file contains data classes and parsing logic for 'TalkDirective' objects, which are used to interpret and process directive strings formatted as JSON within voice-related features of the application. It defines the structure of directives, parsing methods, and key management to differentiate directive content from other text.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing various parameters for speech directives, including voice settings, model identifiers, and output configurations.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the result of parsing a directive string, including the parsed directive, cleaned text, and unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: Object providing static methods to parse directive strings into TalkDirective objects, handling JSON parsing and key extraction.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a text string into a TalkDirectiveParseResult, extracting directives if present.
